params.caption.lyrics:
[Intro - clean chiming guitar figure, no drums]

[Intro - wah guitar and full trio enter]

[Verse 1 - rolling, one chord groove]
Been gone long enough to lose my drawl
Got it back the second I stepped down
Same man selling peanuts by the depot
Same dog asleep on the same hot ground

[Verse 2 - rolling]
Twelve years and a borrowed suitcase
Nothing in it worth the freight
Reckon nobody's fixing to forgive me
Reckon I'm not fixing to wait

[Chorus - heavy, wah and fuzz]
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Tell it slow and tell it plain
Been a long time gone to yonder
Come to stand out in the rain
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Same clothes and the same crooked name
Every road I ever ruined
Runs back through here all the same

[Verse 3 - rolling]
Aunt Cleo's still got the kettle
Still won't let a man sit down
Says the Lord don't keep a ledger
Says the town keeps one around

[Chorus - heavy, wah and fuzz]
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Tell it slow and tell it plain
Been a long time gone to yonder
Come to stand out in the rain
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Same clothes and the same crooked name
Every road I ever ruined
Runs back through here all the same

[Verse 4 - rolling, quieter]
Mailbox got my name misspelled
Been that way for twenty years
Much obliged to whoever painted
Anything at all out here

[Guitar Solo - long, wah and fuzz, full trio, building]

[Bridge - half time, heavy]
I don't aim to be forgiven
I aim to be understood
Difference ain't worth arguing
When the water's up for good

[Chorus - heavy, full band]
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Tell it slow and tell it plain
Been a long time gone to yonder
Come to stand out in the rain

[Chorus - heavy, doubled and shouted]
TELL THE RIVER I'M COMING
Same clothes and the same crooked name
Every road I ever ruined
Runs back through here all the same

[Outro - extended guitar jam, feedback, long slow fade]
params.file.name: Tell the River Im Coming
